queries: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

SELECT AVG(r) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId) x

SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x;

SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x;

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

assumptions.assumption: Media types with no tracks above the size threshold are excluded (they have no average), so the final average covers only media types with qualifying tracks.
Bytes is cast to a real number to avoid integer division; the per-type average is the mean of per-track ratios, not total bytes divided by total milliseconds.

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type value computed as total bytes divided by total milliseconds (ratio of sums) instead of the mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(r) AS value FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, SUM(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL)) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS r FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpms) FROM (SELECT mt.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpms FROM Track t JOIN MediaType mt ON mt.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY mt.MediaTypeId) x

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId (names are one-to-one with ids); only media types having at least one track above the byte threshold are included in the outer average.
Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track ratios Bytes/Milliseconds, computed with real (non-integer) division, not total bytes divided by total milliseconds.

responses.sql: SELECT AVG(avg_bpm) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS avg_bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x;

assumptions.assumption: Per-media-type average is the mean of per-track Bytes/Milliseconds ratios (not total bytes / total milliseconds), computed with real division to avoid integer truncation.
Only media types having at least one track above the byte threshold are included in the outer simple average; media types are grouped by id and name (names assumed distinct per id).

alternatives.interpretation: Per-media-type average computed as ratio of sums (total Bytes / total Milliseconds) rather than the mean of per-track ratios.
alternatives.sql: SELECT AVG(bpm) AS avg_of_avgs FROM (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, CAST(SUM(t.Bytes) AS REAL) / SUM(t.Milliseconds) AS bpm FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name) x;
